To fund this, Marcus is considering converting TimberCraft from a sole trader into a Private Limited Company (LTD) by selling shares to family members. However, local environmental pressure groups are protesting against increased tree felling, creating conflicts between Marcus's profit objectives and the local community's social objectives.
